name: Konan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Konan city emblem in blue and green: a blue oval above a small green oval, like a stylised lake.
history: Municipal flag of Konan, a city in Shiga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 2004.

features.role: Konan city emblem — a blue oval above a small green oval, like a stylised lake
